about.title: Professional Profile
about.text: I am a Senior Software & AI Product Engineer focused on turning unstable foundation models into fast, reliable products users actually pay for. By pairing decoupled Ports & Adapters architecture with practical product execution, I enable teams to swap AI providers in hours, control token and media generation costs, and deliver responsive experiences that feel native from mobile to desktop.
specialties: Multimodal AI Systems: Multi-model image, video, voice & Hybrid RAG orchestration (OpenRouter, OpenAI, Gemini)
AI FinOps & Reliability: Pre-reserved budget guardrails, capability validation, async job polling & Vision QA loops
Adaptive Product UX: Mobile-first native-style interfaces, progressive disclosure & real-time media playback
Decoupled Architecture: Hexagonal (Ports & Adapters), Next.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL & Redis for high-concurrency scale

experience.title: Professional Experience
experience.description: Proven track record taking AI-native products, multi-platform apps, and mission-critical backends from zero to production.

entries.responsibilities: Architected and shipped a two-sided heavy-freight marketplace and escrow platform (somosflet.com) across web and mobile using agentic coding workflows. Built a DDD-structured Bun + Elysia + Drizzle backend powering a double-entry accounting ledger, dual-currency settlement (USD/VES rate locking), tax withholdings, and an OTP/photo delivery state machine, alongside Astro, Next.js, and React Native clients.

Applied formal verification principles in Dafny, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), and Clean Architecture to high-integrity transactional gaming prototypes. Engineered internal AI coding-agent workflows that enforced Clean Code boundaries, domain invariants, and automated quality checks across rapid R&D iterations.

Owned the production AI infrastructure powering autonomous freight workflows. Engineered resilient ReAct + tool-calling agents, real-time conversational voice orchestration (RetellAI), and n8n recovery pipelines with strict latency monitoring and cost-optimized model routing.

Spearheaded end-to-end delivery of a high-concurrency medical booking ecosystem. Built fault-tolerant payment orchestrations with MercadoPago, eliminated database bottlenecks under peak load, and refactored core modules into strict TypeScript to accelerate feature velocity.

Built 2 high-traffic web applications from the ground up in agile cross-functional teams. Standardized reusable UI component libraries, automated CI/CD release pipelines, and maintained 99.9% production uptime with strong test coverage.

projects.title: Featured Projects
projects.description: Production-ready AI systems and high-concurrency products combining clean architecture with measurable business impact.

projects.title: DriftZero Studio - Multimodal AI Ad Pipeline
projects.description: End-to-end e-commerce commercial studio turning a single product photo into consistent multi-shot video ads. Features capability-aware OpenRouter routing across text, vision, image, and video models, visual DNA extraction with a self-healing Vision QA retry loop, pre-reserved FinOps budget guardrails, and an adaptive 3-tier Mobile-Native Stack, Tablet, and Desktop UX.

projects.title: Loadify AI - Logistics Orchestrator
projects.description: Enterprise B2B SaaS automating freight discovery and live carrier rate negotiation via Hybrid RAG and Voice AI agents. Cut manual operational time by 90% while maintaining high availability, predictable latency, and cost-controlled inference.

projects.title: TLDR Bot - Hexagonal RAG Assistant
projects.description: High-precision RAG assistant refactored with Ports & Adapters to decouple core retrieval logic from AI providers and chat surfaces (Telegram/Discord), allowing instant platform expansion. Combines semantic (pgvector) + lexical (tsvector) Hybrid Search with re-ranking.

projects.title: Graggle - High-Concurrency Mobile Mini App
projects.description: Mobile-first Telegram gaming Mini App built for mass concurrency inside constrained mobile webviews. Powered by Next.js Server Actions and Redis-backed async state management, plus a live analytics dashboard for real-time economy balancing.

projects.title: Event-Driven Microservices Architecture
projects.description: Distributed backend ecosystem built with NestJS and NATS for resilient inter-service event messaging. Features polyglot persistence (PostgreSQL, MongoDB), Stripe transaction processing, and containerized Docker orchestration.

projects.title: Karma Bot - Real-Time Engagement Engine
projects.description: Production community micro-rewards engine actively serving high-traffic Telegram groups. Built on Node.js and MongoDB for low-latency asynchronous event processing, anti-abuse tracking, and live leaderboard analytics.
